We need to call the function database_us_census_get_population for each area. The function signature: area: string, type: string, year?: number. We can use default year 2000 if not specified. But likely we want recent year? The user didn't specify year. We can use default 2000. But maybe better to ask clarifying question? The user didn't specify year. We could ask for clarification. But the instruction says: "If you do not have enough information to answer the user's request, ask clarifying questions." We don't have enough info: which year? So we should ask clarifying question.
